title: The release result, the release instruction, the confirmation read and the case outcome are not specified for rwb-treatment
source: Legacy RWB-E3-017 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E3-017, lines 2558 to 2660); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.17 and A1.2 FEAT-TRT-17; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T4 SETTLEMENT and RESTRUCTURE and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-RES-33, R-SET-20, R-SET-21 and R-DIL-27; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 features sheet row FEAT-TRT-17 and integrations sheet row INT-03; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 5, 11 and 13; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-05, DP-13 and DP-19
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1, AC2 and AC4; 8 Business rules; 9 State transitions; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.4; 12.6; 12.7; 13 Solution plan; 14 Validation and messages
description: One combined row for the collateral release. (1) The release result has no field anywhere: TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 and none of them is a release status, a request reference, a released date or a confirmation time, FSD S2 A2.17 has no field catalog at all, and the legacy data table names the view fields only as ranges DF-ACE-001 to DF-ACE-042, DF-ACE-043 to DF-ACE-054, DF-ACE-091 to DF-ACE-098 and DF-ACE-196 to DF-ACE-207. (2) The condition of R-RES-33 is installments_paid = installments_due and no field called installments_due exists in TSD S2 T3.1, which carries installments (DF-TRT-009) and installments_paid (DF-TRT-032) only. (3) The release instruction has no source shape, no message identifier, no operation and no call type: the legacy story says it leaves 'through the outbound interface to CCMS', the connection matrix of Architecture v5 slide 13 gives rwb-treatment no cell to P2 rwb-integration and none to Outside, and the Work Package records no C and no X dependency, so neither the carrier nor the payload can be copied. (4) The confirmation of the release is detected by re-reading v_ace_collateral and v_ace_collateral_detail and testing 'in_active is false', and no named view field carries that fact, no source fixes a re-read interval, a confirmation limit or whether CCMS sends a message of its own. (5) The rules end with the case in a new state (PLAN_COMPLETED, COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED, CASE_CLOSED_SETTLED, ASSET_ON_BOOKS) and no source states how a stage reports that outcome to rwb-case, which owns the case, its tasks and its clocks. (6) No source fixes the decision code the request and the confirmation carry, nor a message text for a release that is requested and not confirmed. (7) Whether v_ace_account, v_ace_payment, v_ace_collateral and v_ace_collateral_detail are read directly by rwb-treatment or through the contract read of rwb-source-data is not stated for this story: DP-05 allows both and the architecture says the recovery.v_ace_* views are read only by rwb-source-data. (8) The settlement clearance event that starts R-SET-20 has no row in the event catalogue, so its name cannot be copied from a source.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (treatment fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, no release, request-reference or released-date field, and no installments_due field) and T4 SETTLEMENT (R-SET-14 PAYMENT_CLEARED, R-SET-20 COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED on CLEARANCE_CONFIRMED, R-SET-21 CASE_CLOSED_SETTLED on COLLATERAL_RELEASED) and RESTRUCTURE (R-RES-33 PLAN_RUNNING to PLAN_COMPLETED, condition installments_paid = installments_due); TSD S2 v2 T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004 only, none of them a release operation); FSD S2 v3 A2.17.3.1 (rules R-RES-33, R-SET-20, R-DIL-27, BR-S2-017) and A2.17.2 (integration points 'CCMS, ALS and GL', prerequisites FEAT-CHO-08); legacy RWB-E3-017 story text ('The release leaves through the outbound interface to CCMS, ACE holds the release state, and the Workbench records its own request and confirmation'), data table and acceptance criteria AC1 and AC2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-RES-33 ('Workbench | ALS core, CCMS, Workbench | None'), R-SET-20 ('Workbench | ALS core, CCMS | None'), R-SET-21 ('Workbench | CCMS, the Workbench document hub, Workbench | None') and R-DIL-27; Event and Messaging Design v4 catalogue rows EV-10 to EV-12 (no clearance event for settlement funds); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 13 row 'S2 Treatment' (E and T to P7, E to S8, T to P5, T and E to P8, N to ACE Common, no P2 and no Outside cell) and slide 11 (own schema 'state + decision record', outbox to Kafka)
area: Contract and data: release result, instruction carrier, confirmation read, case outcome
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P3 owner of the case contract, the P8 owner of the payment contract, the P1 owner of the ACE read and the platform integration owner of the CCMS adapter
proposed: Apply the working read of ASM-B2-S2-012-1 to ASM-B2-S2-012-6 with RWB-S2-E3017-CON and RWB-S2-E3017-APP: the release answer is an optional collateralRelease section of the treatment read of RWB-S2-E3001-CON, the release facts are values of the ACE read and never a column of rwb_treatment and never a derivation in code, the instruction leaves as rwb.treatment.CollateralReleaseRequested.v1 on rwb.treatment.events.v1 and is carried to CCMS by the platform adapter, the confirmation is the same ACE read showing the security inactive, the parent CaseWorkflow moves the case and closes the treatment, the R-RES-33 comparison is made on installments and installments_paid, and the clearance arrives on the rwb-payment event. Confirm the view grant and the in_active column name with the P1 owner, the clearance event with the P8 owner and the adapter with the platform integration owner at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: The published shape of the release section, of the two release events, of the release vocabulary and of the view column contract has no source
source: Legacy RWB-E3-017 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E3-017, lines 2558 to 2660); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.17; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Event and Messaging Design v4 catalogue; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-05, DP-13 and R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC6; 9 State transitions; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.7; 12.8; 13 Solution plan
description: A contract row with nothing to copy. (1) No source names a release resource, a release section or a release element, so the section name, its ten properties and the split between stored, read and computed properties are unpublished. (2) No source states whether the release answer is served inside the treatment read, on a sub-path of its own or through a separate read, and the TSD endpoint inventory stops at the four treatment operations. (3) The two release events have no catalogue row: EV-10 is TreatmentApproved and EV-11 is TreatmentBooked, so the names, the payload properties, the dedupe key and the retry and .dlt topics cannot be copied. (4) The legacy AC1 and R-SET-21 speak of a request and of a confirmation without naming a status value, so the release vocabulary is unpublished and no value may be invented as the bank's. (5) The four views are given only by field ranges and the in_active fact carries no column name, so the read-only column contract cannot be copied from a source. (6) No source gives the error answers of a read that carries an optional section, and the legacy message table names six identifiers of the module without mapping them to status codes.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (no release element and no release field) and T-A.1 (four treatment operations, no release read); FSD S2 v3 A2.17 (main success flow AC-S2-017-01 with no field catalog and no element) and A2.17.3.1 (rules R-RES-33, R-SET-20 and R-DIL-27 only); legacy RWB-E3-017 endpoints table (treatment create and treatment read only), validation table (MSG-S2-001, MSG-S2-002, MSG-S2-003, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002, MSG-P7-003 with no status code) and story text ('the Workbench records its own request and confirmation'); Event and Messaging Design v4 catalogue (EV-10 TreatmentApproved, EV-11 TreatmentBooked, EV-12 PaymentMissed, no release event); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-SET-21 ('CCMS confirms the release'); Template and Rules v1 R7.2 s12 (tables 12.1 to 12.9) and R5.5 DP-05
area: Contract: release section, two release events, release vocabulary, view column contract, error set
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-treatment tech lead, the P3 owner of the case contract, the P1 owner of the ACE read and the platform integration owner of the CCMS adapter
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-012-3 and ASM-B2-S2-012-6 as the rwb-treatment contract v1: the collateralRelease section as an optional addition to the answer of GET /treatments/{treatmentId} at the same major version with releaseStatus, requestRef, requestedAt, releasedAt, checkedAt, collateralCount, collateralNo, assetKey, ruleId and ruleVersion; the event schemas rwb.treatment.CollateralReleaseRequested.v1 and rwb.treatment.CollateralReleased.v1 on rwb.treatment.events.v1 with a CloudEvents envelope, a stable dedupe key and the service retry and .dlt topics; the release vocabulary of the five answer states tied to the read fact; the four view ranges marked read only; and 401, 403 with MSG-P4-002, 404, 422 with MSG-GEN-001 and 503 with MSG-P7-003 for the errors. Confirm the section with the owner of RWB-S2-E3001-CON and the two events with the platform integration owner at the wave 2 contract freeze.
